context_requirements: Expression of NR1I3 (CAR) or a constitutively active CAR variant
Hepatocyte-like transcriptional coactivators for robust CYP induction
Presence of CAR response elements in target gene promoters
Ligand access to nuclear receptor; no requirement for high proliferation
falsifiers: No increase in any CAR target gene at 24 h in HEPG2 or other lines
Strong and reproducible induction of CYP2B6/CYP3A4 at 6 h in all lines
Predominant downregulation of drug-metabolizing enzymes and transporters
No difference between CAR agonist and vehicle across all nine lines
